statements.status_notes: Kubernetes 1.33 links github.com/opencontainers/selinux 1.11.1. Upstream fixed CVE-2025-52881 in opencontainers/selinux 1.13.0, but kube-apiserver 1.33 has not adopted that dependency version.
Kubernetes 1.33 links github.com/opencontainers/selinux 1.11.1. Upstream fixed CVE-2025-52881 in opencontainers/selinux 1.13.0, but kube-apiserver 1.33 has not adopted that dependency version.

CVE-2025-52881 is a runc procfs write vulnerability that requires container runtime execution context. The kube-controller-manager binary does not execute container runtime code paths; the opencontainers/selinux module is linked transitively through Kubernetes but its container-launching code paths are unreachable from this binary.
